entities.name: Ceolwulf I of Mercia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ceolwulf I was the King of Mercia, a kingdom of Anglo-Saxon England, from 821 until his deposition in 823. He was the brother of Coenwulf, his predecessor, and was deposed by Beornwulf.
